（自由記述欄）
Enrollment in the Personal Accident Insurance for Students Pursuing Education and Research (Gakkensai) is mandatory. Students are advised to confirm with the Academic Affairs Office in advance whether they are covered by the insurance.
In addition, enrollment is limited to students who are able to demonstrate appropriate social manners and professional conduct at internship and fieldwork sites.
Because this course requires both safety training and research ethics training, students who have not completed “Introduction to Educational Field Research” are, in principle, not eligible to enroll. However, concurrent enrollment in that course is permitted.
A pre-enrollment consultation session (in person) will be held on Tuesday, April 7, from 4:40 p.m. to 5:40 p.m. Students wishing to enroll should register in advance using the following form:
https://forms.gle/xFhpb6nL9TVVanSZ7
An information session on the San Francisco and Silicon Valley Study Program will be held by the program coordinators. The date and time will be announced once confirmed. Students interested in participating should register in advance using the following form:
https://forms.gle/Mkc4uAbaBmQvfB9aA
Students should enroll in Overseas Coursework I before taking Overseas Coursework II. Overseas Coursework II is intended for students participating in the program for a second time, including those undertaking an internship.
履修条件
Students are expected to demonstrate appropriate social manners and professional conduct.
Participation in the San Francisco and Silicon Valley Study Program requires a selection interview conducted in English. The New Mongolia Academy Summer School Internship Program also has a selection process that includes an interview and the submission of application documents.
授業概要
この講義では、外国でサマースクールやボランティア活動に従事することを目的とする。自己開拓で見つけてきたものは、所定の申請方法に基づいて、申請を行う。また、サンフランシスコ、シリコンバレー研修（米国、８月、２月）や新モンゴル学園の日本語教師体験（９月）の紹介を行うこともできる。
The purpose of this lecture is to engage in summer school or volunteer work in a foreign country. Those found through self-exploration will apply based on the prescribed application procedures. The program can also introduce students to San Francisco and Silicon Valley training (U.S.A., August and February) and the Japanese language teaching experience at the New Mongolian Academy (September).
